raw_output:
Giver: Hi, can you hear me?
Follower: Yeah, I can. Ready?
Giver: Okay. Let's get started. Find the cross marked START.
Follower: Got it. It's right near the top left.
Giver: Good. Now, look at the diamond mine. Where is it on your map?
Follower: Ah, that's the one with the little diamond shape. It's a bit lower than the start.
Giver: Perfect. It's pretty close to the start, just to the right.
Follower: Okay, I see it.
Giver: Now, pretend you are walking from the START towards that mine. Don't go directly to it. Walk straight up a bit first.
Follower: Straight up? Like, north?
Giver: Yes. Walk up until you are level with the top edge of the diamond mine.
Follower: Okay, I'm walking up... now I'm past the mine.
Giver: Good. Now turn right and walk towards the mine.
Follower: Okay, turning right. I'm heading towards it now.
Giver: Stop when you are right next to it. That's your first segment.
Follower: Okay, I've reached the mine.
Giver: Now, from the mine, walk diagonally up and to the left.
Follower: Up and left? Towards the top?
Giver: Yes. Walk towards the highest viewpoint, but stop before you reach it.
Follower: Okay, I'm going up and left... wait, I'm almost at the viewpoint.
Giver: No, stop short! Don't touch the viewpoint. Just get as close as you can without hitting it.
Follower: Okay, stopping just before it.
Giver: Now turn right and walk towards the springboks.
Follower: Springboks? I don't see any animals on my map.
Giver: Just keep going in that direction. Walk towards the general area of the springboks, but stop when you hit the overgrown gully.
Follower: Oh! The gully? Okay, I see that. I'm walking towards it now.
Giver: Good. Stop right at the edge of the gully.
Follower: Okay, stopped.
Giver: Now turn left and walk down towards the field station. Which one?
Follower: There are two field stations.
Giver: The one that is higher up. The top one.
Follower: Ah, the one near the top left corner. Okay, walking down towards that one.
Giver: Stop when you are close to it, but not right on top of it.
Follower: Okay, stopped near the top station.
Giver: Now walk towards the banana tree.
Follower: Okay, walking towards the banana tree.
Giver: Stop when you are right next to it.
Follower: Okay, next to the banana tree.
Giver: Now walk diagonally down and to the left.
Follower: Down and left? Towards the gold mine?
Giver: No, don't go to the gold mine. Walk towards the rockfall instead.
Follower: Wait, where is the rockfall?
Giver: It's way down near the bottom left. Keep walking down and left until you hit the rockfall.
Follower: Okay, walking down... oh no, I missed the banana tree!
Giver: What? You missed the banana tree?
Follower: I thought the gold mine was the next stop. I went straight to the gold mine.
Giver: Oh, that's the problem! I said go to the rockfall. The gold mine is just a landmark you pass. You need to go to the rockfall.
Follower: Oh no. Okay, let me retrace. Back to the banana tree.
Giver: Yes, go back to the banana tree. Then walk towards the rockfall.
Follower: Okay, back to the banana tree... now walking towards the rockfall.
Giver: Good. Stop when you reach the rockfall.
Follower: Okay, reached the rockfall.
Giver: Now turn right and walk up towards the rope bridge.
Follower: Okay, turning right... walking up... I see the rope bridge.
Giver: Good. Stop right next to the rope bridge.
Follower: Okay, next to the bridge.
Giver: Now walk towards the safari truck.
Follower: The safari truck? I see it, but it's pretty far away.
Giver: Keep going towards it. Walk all the way to it.
Follower: Okay, walking towards the truck... oh, I'm passing a giraffe now.
Giver: Yes, you should pass the giraffes on your right side. Keep going until you reach the truck.
Follower: Okay, passing the giraffes... reaching the truck.
Giver: Good. Now turn left and walk down towards the disused warehouse.
Follower: Disused warehouse? I don't see that on my map.
Giver: Just keep walking down and left. You'll hit the warehouse eventually.
Follower: Okay, walking down... I don't see any warehouse. Just trees and rocks.
Giver: It's the big square shape near the bottom. You might have missed it because it's hidden behind some rocks.
Follower: Ah, there it is! The disused warehouse. Okay, I'm walking towards it.
Giver: Stop when you are close to it.
Follower: Okay, stopped near the warehouse.
Giver: Now walk towards the crocodiles.
Follower: Crocodiles? I see them in the water. Okay, walking towards the crocodiles.
Giver: Stop when you are right next to them.
Follower: Okay, next to the crocodiles.
Giver: Now turn right and walk down towards the great lake.
Follower: The great lake? That's the big blue area at the bottom.
Giver: Yes. Walk towards it. But wait, don't go straight there. First, walk past the safari truck again, but this time go further left.
Follower: Wait, I already passed the truck. I thought I was done.
Giver: No, you haven't finished yet. From the crocodiles, walk left until you are above the great lake. Then walk down to the lake.
Follower: Okay, walking left... above the lake... now walking down to the lake.
Giver: Stop when you are right next to the lake.
Follower: Okay, next to the lake.
Giver: Now walk towards the FINISH. It's marked with a cross.
Follower: Where is the finish? I don't see it.
Giver: It's at the very bottom left corner. Near the lake.
Follower: Ah, there it is! The finish line. Okay, walking towards it.
Giver: Stop when you reach it.
Follower: Okay, I've reached the finish!
Giver: Great job. Did you make it?
Follower: Yes! I followed the route correctly.
Giver: Excellent. Thanks for your help.
Follower: You're welcome. Bye!
Giver: Bye!
